goal: Unattended sessions have no context limit today: CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE was removed 2026-10-18 (600149c4e, 'turn budget replaces compaction') and the turn_meter hook that enforced the turn budget is no longer wired in .claude/settings.json after the 2026-10-24 hook trim, so auto-compaction fires only at 97% of 1M. Put back env CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE=25 (it existed 825a6d626, 2026-10-16) in .claude/settings.json, and fix WORKERS.md rule 5 text that still describes the unwired turn_meter caps. Apply only AFTER pilot 1 ends (no change mid-pilot); measure it as its own pilot (same 4 workers, coordinator context and compactions compared with pilot 1). Why 25% not 12-15%: base context is ~75-85k, so 15% leaves ~65k working room; a compaction costs about one full cache rewrite (~2x the new prefix) and breaks even after ~60 turns at 150k but ~25 turns at 250k. Operator 2026-10-24 asked for compaction in super sessions; D5 notes file makes it safe.
note: HOLD (MTS_Doctor 2026-10-24): operator rule: attended sessions (Thinker, monitored Fable runs) may grow as the work needs, compaction by the operator watching live; only unattended sessions (super session, workers) get a compaction limit. A project-wide env override would also hit attended sessions, so do not apply it as written. Waiting on the Doctor's research (Anthropic + community) on per-session compaction; the card is rewritten from that result.
title: Auto-compact at 25% for all sessions (CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE=25), after pilot 1
